plan.goal: Explore and critique the UX of FleetAtlas, focusing on the primary dashboard flow, adjacent pages (alerts, analytics, vehicles), key interactions (vehicle details, alerts, analytics), and mobile responsiveness.
plan.summary: Start with the dashboard (index.html) to validate real-time updates, vehicle interactions, and detail panel actions. Then explore alerts.html, analytics.html, and vehicles.html, checking their unique features and interactions. Repeat critical checks on mobile viewport. Validate high-risk actions like reassigning tasks and alert handling.
assumptions: The site's JS functionality (e.g., real-time updates, detail panel sliding) works as described in the prescan.
risk_hotspots: index.html (real-time vehicle updates, reassign task confirmation)

phases.title: Dashboard (index.html) Exploration
phases.objective: Validate dashboard interactions, real-time updates, and detail panel actions.
key_checks: Check real-time vehicle position updates (wait 5 seconds for jitter)
Click a vehicle icon to open the detail panel
Interact with status filters (All, Running, etc.)
exit_criteria: All key dashboard interactions tested, real-time updates observed, detail panel and reassign task validated.

phases.title: Alerts Center (alerts.html) Exploration
phases.objective: Validate alert handling, KPI cards, and filtering.
key_checks: Check KPI cards (open, new today, etc.)
Filter alerts by severity, type, and status
exit_criteria: Alert filtering and actions validated, KPI cards reviewed.

phases.title: Analytics (analytics.html) Exploration
phases.objective: Validate analytics dashboard, KPI cards, and driver performance.
key_checks: Review KPI cards (total mileage, fuel economy, etc.)
exit_criteria: Analytics dashboard features validated, KPI cards and heatmap reviewed.

phases.title: Vehicles (vehicles.html) Exploration
phases.objective: Validate vehicle list, filtering, and details.
key_checks: Test vehicle list filtering (status, fleet, etc.)
Click a vehicle to view details
exit_criteria: Vehicle list filtering and details validated, search functionality tested.

phases.title: Mobile Viewport Validation
phases.objective: Validate critical interactions on mobile viewport.
key_checks: Repeat critical checks (e.g., vehicle detail panel, alert filtering, analytics KPI cards) on mobile viewport
Check small tap targets identified in layout warnings
exit_criteria: Critical interactions validated on mobile, small tap targets reviewed.

coverage_targets.pages: Visit all 4 known HTML pages (index, alerts, analytics, vehicles).
coverage_targets.features: Exercise most visible controls (filters, buttons, search, detail panels) on each key page.
coverage_targets.mobile: Repeat critical checks (dashboard interactions, alert handling, vehicle details) on mobile viewport.

notes: Pay attention to real-time updates on the dashboard. Validate confirmation modals for destructive actions (e.g., reassign task). Check layout warnings for small tap targets on mobile.
